description: Which LLM is the cheapest that still passes? Lists every published Clearbar verdict: the task, the pass bar, the cheapest passing model, its cost per successful task (retries and failures counted) and the page to check it. Optional filter by task type.

task.description: Only verdicts of this task type, for example classification, extraction or tool-call.

name: list_verdicts

app_url.description: Where to run the same verdict on your own examples.

prices_as_of.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the newest price snapshot behind the figures.

cheapest_passing_model.description: The cheapest model that clears the bar; null when none does.

cost_per_successful_task_usd.description: US dollars per successful task, retries and failures counted.

pass_bar.description: Pass-rate threshold the cheapest model has to clear (0 to 1).

slug.description: Verdict slug, the key for get_verdict.

verdict_url.description: The verdict page, with the evidence.
